source_comment: COMMENTS 1,"CSWD China Standard Weather Data for Analyzing Building Thermal Conditions May 2010. China Meteorological Bureau-Climate Information Center-Climate Data Office and Tsinghua University-Department of Building Science and Technology"
time_basis: Typical meteorological year, not a measured consecutive calendar year. EPW local standard time UTC+8; ending-hour observations. Calendar years in EPW are not experiment day types.
calendar: Every selected seven-day weather block is assigned Monday 00:00 through Sunday 23:30. No daily state reset.
interpolation: Linear interpolation from hourly ending-hour temperatures to half-hour left-edge timestamps; annual boundary uses preceding year-end observation.

screening.rule: 21 consecutive non-overlapping 7-day candidates starting Nov 1, ending Mar 27. Keep the first 11 chronologically whose constant-inventory constructive reference passes independent full-trajectory physical validation at all five scales with graph seed 42. No economic optimization or learning model used.
screening.configuration: configs/experiment.toml schema 2 default equipment and P4 demand; constructor tested by replacing only weather; full screening seed is 42. Other seeds and altered parameters require their own reference validation.
screening.calendar_note: The chronological candidate traversal wraps Dec 31 to Jan 1 within the typical meteorological year; start_hour_of_year uses a non-leap 365-day index.
screening.split: First 8 accepted weeks train; next 2 validation; final 1 test. Never reshuffled by scenario seed.
